Six months ago, I would've given Grok five stars without hesitation. Today, I struggle to give it one. And honestly? That breaks my heart more than I expected it to. I wanted this to work. I loved this app. But love without trust doesn't last—and right now, trust is completely broken. Would I recommend Grok? Not anymore. Not until they fix this. Not until they start treating their paying users with the respect they deserve."
